name: Campingplatz Pfronten
beschreibung: The Pfronten campsite is located in the tranquil municipality of Pfronten in Austrian Tirol. Nestled in the impressive mountain landscape of the Alpen, the surroundings are ideal for nature lovers. The campsite's facilities are modern and practical, including a playground and a central supply station. The quiet and family-friendly atmosphere makes it a popular destination for couples and families. Hikers and cyclists gladly use the site as a starting point for tours in the surrounding area. In winter, too, the campsite is appreciated for its proximity to the ski areas. Guests regularly praise the value for money as well as the warm hospitality.
